findings.where: qdonis-backend/src/studio/agent/studio-agent.service.ts (runStep, post-loop `if (signal.aborted) return;` and the catch branch)
findings.problem: If the client stops or disconnects mid-stream, it keeps the streamed text and the step is never charged, although Bedrock bills the ~12k-token prompt. Even when usage metadata already arrived, an abort skips the charge. This is documented as D9.
findings.fix: Charge whenever usage was received, even if the signal aborted afterwards. Consider charging a prompt-size estimate on mid-stream abort, or get explicit product sign-off and keep it in the ledger.

findings.where: qdonis-backend/src/ai/ai.service.ts prepare() as used by StudioAgentService.prepare
findings.problem: The gate only checks `balance > 0`, and one Studio step costs more than the 10k signup bonus. Parallel requests from a low-balance user are all served, and only the remainder is collected.
findings.fix: Add a per-user in-flight limit for POST /studio/agent, or reserve tokens before calling Bedrock.

findings.where: qdonis/lib/studio/agent.ts openAgentStream (and services/bedrockService.ts, which it copies)
findings.problem: On 401 it calls getAccessToken() again. That returns the cached token until refreshAt, so the retry reuses the rejected token.
The HTTP path compares SSE events but not the Bedrock request after ValidationPipe/class-transformer. Parity is proven only for the raw-fixture build.
findings.fix: Assert fake.sent[0].input deep-equals fixture.expected_request in the e2e happy path.

findings.problem: Role `system`, numeric id/tool_use_id and non-string text now return 400, where Python skipped or str()-coerced them. These are not listed among the D11 deviations.
findings.fix: Add these cases to the ledger's deviation list. Relax the DTO only if a client needs them.

findings.problem: /ai/bedrock/converse now retries throttles and 5xx (up to 3 attempts), where the old fetch client made a single call. This changes latency on failure. The contract is otherwise unchanged.
findings.fix: Note it in the ledger, or pass a per-command single attempt for converse() if the old behaviour matters.
